 What’s Open, Closed On Thanksgiving 2026 In Andover
 Dave Copeland
 By 
 Dave Copeland 
 🕒
 November 17, 2026 
 ANDOVER, MA — Thursday, Nov. 26, is Thanksgiving, and in Massachusetts that means most large large retailers — including grocery stores and liquor stores — will be closed under the state’s blue laws. If you’re cooking, you’ll want to have your key ingredients on hand before the holiday.
 Here’s a look at what’s open and closed in Andover and across Massachusetts on Nov. 26, 2025 :
 Government
 Trash & recycling: 
Collections following a town-recognized holiday are delayed one day. If your normal pickup is Thursday , it will be picked up Friday ; Friday routes move to Saturday .
(Note: There is no curbside leaf collection during Thanksgiving week ; fall leaf pickup resumes the following week.)
 Town Offices: Closed Thursday and Friday for the holiday.
 Schools: Andover Public Schools are closed Thursday and Friday for Thanksgiving break; students have a half-day on Wednesday, Nov. 26 .
 Memorial Hall Library: 
 Closes early at 5 p.m. on Wednesday, Nov. 26 
 Closed Thursday, Nov. 27, and Friday, Nov. 28 ; normal hours resume Saturday.
 Robb Center (Senior Center): Closed Thursday and Friday for Thanksgiving.
 Cormier Youth Center: Closed Thursday and Friday .
 State and federal government offices: Closed.
 Mail: Post offices are closed and there is no regular mail delivery or package service on Thanksgiving, except Priority Mail Express.
 Transportation
 MBTA: 
 Commuter Rail on a weekend schedule 
 Subways, buses and The RIDE on a Sunday/holiday schedule 
 Offered a $10 Holiday/Weekend Commuter Rail Pass 
Riders should check mbta.com closer to the holiday for the final schedule.
 Merrimack Valley Transit (MeVa): 
No bus or van service on Thanksgiving Day ; regular service resumes Friday, Nov. 28 .
 Retail & Services
 Because of Massachusetts blue laws, Thanksgiving is a “full commerce restriction” holiday : most large retail stores and grocery chains must close, and liquor stores are not allowed to operate.
 Retail stores: Most large chains (big-box, department stores, malls) are closed. Some small convenience and specialty shops may open at the owner’s discretion.
 Banks: Closed (federal holiday).
 Liquor stores: Closed statewide; off-premise alcohol sales are prohibited.
 Supermarkets / big grocery chains: Closed (Market Basket, Stop & Shop, Trader Joe’s, Whole Foods and others).
 Convenience stores & gas stations: Many remain open, often with reduced or holiday hours — check your specific store.
 Cannabis dispensaries: Hours vary by business; many close for the day or operate shortened schedules.
 Restaurants, taverns & bars: Many restaurants are closed or offer special Thanksgiving seatings; some bars and taverns open later in the day. Hours vary — call ahead.
 Pharmacies: Some CVS and Walgreens locations remain open with holiday hours, though in-store pharmacies may close.
 Movie theaters: Many operate on Thanksgiving with modified hours.
 U.S. Stock Market: NYSE and Nasdaq are closed on Thanksgiving Day ; markets close early (1 p.m.) on Friday, Nov. 28 .
 Feaster Five Road Race & Local Traffic
 The 39th annual Feaster Five Road Race is scheduled for Thanksgiving morning in Andover, continuing the town’s long-running holiday tradition.
 Drivers should expect temporary road closures and delays in and around Downtown Andover, Shawsheen Square and the race route from early morning through mid-morning. In recent years, closures have run roughly from 7:20 a.m. to 10:30 a.m. on Thanksgiving morning.
